{{- /*
  One site-root llms.txt for the default language.
  Precedence: headless content/llms.md body, then that page's front matter,
  then data/llms.*, then params.llms, then pages discovered on the site.
*/ -}}
{{- $page := site.GetPage "/llms" -}}
{{- $data := site.Data.llms | default dict -}}
{{- $param := site.Params.llms | default dict -}}
{{- $raw := "" -}}
{{- with $page -}}
  {{- $raw = strings.TrimSpace .RawContent -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if $raw -}}
{{- printf "%s\n" $raw -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- $title := "" -}}
{{- $summary := "" -}}
{{- $sections := slice -}}
{{- with $page -}}
  {{- $title = index .Params "title" | default .Title -}}
  {{- $summary = index .Params "summary" | default (index .Params "description") | default .Description -}}
  {{- with index .Params "sections" -}}{{- $sections = . -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if not $title -}}{{- $title = index $data "title" | default "" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $summary -}}{{- $summary = index $data "summary" | default (index $data "description") | default "" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $sections -}}{{- with index $data "sections" -}}{{- $sections = . -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $title -}}{{- $title = index $param "title" | default "" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $summary -}}{{- $summary = index $param "summary" | default (index $param "description") | default "" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $sections -}}{{- with index $param "sections" -}}{{- $sections = . -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $title -}}{{- $title = site.Params.assets.brandName | default site.Title | default "Site" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- if not $summary -}}{{- $summary = .Description | default site.Params.description | default "Information about this site for language models and other agents." -}}{{- end -}}
{{- $title = strings.TrimSpace (replace (printf "%v" $title) "\n" " ") -}}
{{- $summary = strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " (printf "%v" $summary)) -}}
{{- $defaultLang := site.Params.i18n.defaultLang | default site.Language.Lang -}}
{{- $langMeta := partial "lang-meta.html" (dict "lang" site.Language "defaultLang" $defaultLang) -}}
{{- $canonical := strings.TrimSpace .Permalink -}}
{{- if not $sections -}}
  {{- $homeURL := strings.TrimSuffix "/" .Permalink -}}
  {{- $links := slice -}}
  {{- $homeNote := strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " (.Description | plainify)) -}}
  {{- $links = $links | append (dict "name" (.Title | default "Home") "url" .Permalink "note" $homeNote) -}}
  {{- with .Params.home -}}
    {{- with .features -}}
      {{- $note := .description | default .title | default "" -}}
      {{- $links = $links | append (dict "name" (.eyebrow | default "Features") "url" (printf "%s/#features" $homeURL) "note" $note) -}}
    {{- end -}}
    {{- with .pricing -}}
      {{- $note := .description | default .title | default "" -}}
      {{- $links = $links | append (dict "name" (.eyebrow | default "Pricing") "url" (printf "%s/#pricing" $homeURL) "note" $note) -}}
    {{- end -}}
  {{- end -}}
  {{- range sort site.Sections "RelPermalink" -}}
    {{- $sectionNote := strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " (.Description | plainify)) -}}
    {{- $links = $links | append (dict "name" (.Title | default .LinkTitle) "url" .Permalink "note" $sectionNote) -}}
    {{- range .RegularPages -}}
      {{- $pageNote := strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " (.Description | plainify)) -}}
      {{- $links = $links | append (dict "name" (.Title | default .LinkTitle) "url" .Permalink "note" $pageNote) -}}
    {{- end -}}
  {{- end -}}
  {{- $sections = slice (dict "title" "Pages" "links" $links) -}}
  {{- $langLinks := slice -}}
  {{- range site.Sites -}}
    {{- $name := .Language.LanguageName | default .Language.Lang -}}
    {{- $note := "" -}}
    {{- with .Home -}}
      {{- $note = strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " (.Description | plainify)) -}}
    {{- end -}}
    {{- $langLinks = $langLinks | append (dict "name" $name "url" .Home.Permalink "note" $note) -}}
  {{- end -}}
  {{- if gt (len $langLinks) 1 -}}
    {{- $sections = $sections | append (dict "title" "Languages" "links" $langLinks) -}}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $lines := slice -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append (printf "# %s" $title) -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append "" -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append (printf "> %s" $summary) -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append "" -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append (printf "Canonical: %s" $canonical) -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append "" -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append (printf "Language: %s" $langMeta.htmlLang) -}}
{{- $lines = $lines | append "" -}}
{{- range $sections -}}
  {{- $heading := index . "title" | default (index . "heading") | default "Pages" -}}
  {{- $heading = strings.TrimSpace (replace (printf "%v" $heading) "\n" " ") -}}
  {{- $lines = $lines | append (printf "## %s" $heading) -}}
  {{- $lines = $lines | append "" -}}
  {{- $sectionLinks := index . "links" | default (index . "pages") | default slice -}}
  {{- range $sectionLinks -}}
    {{- $name := index . "name" | default (index . "title") | default "Page" -}}
    {{- $name = strings.TrimSpace (replace (replace (printf "%v" $name) "[" "(") "]" ")") -}}
    {{- $url := index . "url" | default (index . "href") | default "" -}}
    {{- $url = strings.TrimSpace (printf "%v" $url) -}}
    {{- if and $url (not (or (hasPrefix $url "https://") (hasPrefix $url "http://") (hasPrefix $url "mailto:"))) -}}
      {{- $url = $url | absURL -}}
    {{- end -}}
    {{- $note := index . "note" | default (index . "description") | default "" -}}
    {{- $note = strings.TrimSpace (replaceRE `\s+` " " (printf "%v" $note)) -}}
    {{- if eq $note "<nil>" -}}{{- $note = "" -}}{{- end -}}
    {{- if and $url (ne $url "<nil>") -}}
    {{- $line := printf "- [%s](%s)" $name $url -}}
    {{- if and $note (ne $note "<nil>") -}}{{- $line = printf "%s: %s" $line $note -}}{{- end -}}
    {{- $lines = $lines | append $line -}}
    {{- $lines = $lines | append "" -}}
    {{- end -}}
  {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- printf "%s\n" (delimit $lines "\n") -}}
{{- end -}}
